$comment: Daily editorial engine for the Chatbot.OM blog. Each weekday has a lane with a rotating topic bank. Dated overrides win over the lane for that date. Working titles are starting points the generator may sharpen but never lengthen. No em or en dashes anywhere in this file. Bank keys and override keys must be unique across the whole file. The reader is the small message-first Omani business (two to ten people); the sister site customercare.om serves operations leads at organisations with staffed phone lines, and the two blogs must never duplicate each other.
